data.long_meaning: A name of great spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, Daiya means 'Caller to Faith'. Derived from the Arabic root 'da'wa' (calling), it carries the profound symbolism of spreading the message of Allah and guiding others towards the righteous path. The name Daiya carries the meaning “Caller to Faith” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daiya usually hope their child will grow to embody caller to faith and live with faith, good character and purpose.
